description: This Scala source file defines the GroupingAnalyticsTransformer object, which transforms grouping analytics operations (CUBE, ROLLUP, GROUPING SETS) into logical plan operators (Expand and Aggregate) within Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst optimizer.

classes.name: GroupingAnalyticsTransformer
classes.description: Object providing methods to transform grouping analytics operations into logical plan operators (Expand and Aggregate) for Spark SQL.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method to transform grouping analytics (CUBE/ROLLUP/GROUPING SETS) into Expand and Aggregate operators.

methods.name: constructGroupByAlias
methods.description: Creates aliases for group by expressions to prevent nulls from affecting aggregates.

methods.name: constructExpand
methods.description: Constructs the Expand operator with grouping sets, adjusting nullability of attributes.

methods.name: constructAggregateExpressions
methods.description: Builds aggregate expressions, replacing grouping functions with appropriate expressions.

methods.name: replaceGroupingFunction
methods.description: Replaces GROUPING and GROUPING_ID functions with expressions extracting bits from the grouping ID.

methods.name: replaceExpressions
methods.description: Replaces group by expressions with expanded attributes from the Expand operator output.
